2_canonical_unit_matrix.compat: legacy percent frozen in DB/API; decimal frozen at SignalInput

2_canonical_unit_matrix.conversion: none; atr_pct = atr/spot derived at consumer
operands must share unit BEFORE ratio

2b_replay_unit_parity_register.statement: Replay/backfill/eval routes copy percent-form DB values into SignalInput fields whose frozen contract is decimal, with no conversion and no consumer-side re-normalization.
evidence_chain: db.py:420 iv_level comment avg IV across chain; db.py:599 realized_vol comment annualized realized vol percent
server.py:6843 stamps snapshot iv_level as percent for DB / iv_rank history (explicit in-code comment); server.py:6950 realized_vol=_realized_vol (percent producer)
signal_types.py:86-88 SignalInput contract: iv_level/realized_vol decimal; ms_dict/DB stay percent
market_state.py:1219-1224 live builder converts via vol_percent_to_decimal — decimal enters SignalInput on live route
features/replay_signal_input_v1.py:40-46 copies row values VERBATIM for every matching SignalInput field name — iv_level and realized_vol match; no conversion
volatility_regime.py:189-194 comment no re-normalize; _f (volatility_regime.py:84-86) is plain finite-float — no scaling
signals.py:458 MC path: iv = float_finite_or_none(inp.iv_level) — no scaling before Monte Carlo blend

volatility_regime.py:89-105 normalize_vol_decimal (the percent heuristic guard) has ZERO production call sites — only tests/test_volatility_regime_fail_closed.py and governance inventories reference it

Replay routes execute the real money path: tools/replay_money_path_probe.py:251-252 (compute_signals), arch_competition/stack_bundle_eval_v1.py:482, arch_competition/ablation_bundle_inference.py:591, tools/backfill_fusion_policy_*.py
2b_replay_unit_parity_register.determinism: DETERMINISTIC by construction for any DB row with percent-form iv_level/realized_vol > 5.0
2b_replay_unit_parity_register.downstream: MC _blend_sigma receives ~100x IV; vol-regime compression/expansion thresholds compare percent values to decimal cutoffs; rv/iv ratio survives (same-unit operands) but level checks do not
2b_replay_unit_parity_register.unexecuted_coverage: numeric downstream magnitudes not executed in this read-only mission — divergence itself proven statically at the field contract boundary
2b_replay_unit_parity_register.designed_reproduction: read-only: SELECT one snapshots row WHERE iv_level > 5; call signal_input_from_snapshot_row_dict; assert inp.iv_level > VOL_DECIMAL_PERCENT_HEURISTIC — violates frozen SignalInput decimal contract

amendments.change: Every concept gains explicit canonical_internal_unit + serialization_unit + unit_assertion columns (unit matrix above is now part of the contract).

Dual-unit boundary is FROZEN: decimal at SignalInput, percent at DB/API. Conversion permitted in exactly one place: the canonical builder. Replay builder must route through the same conversion (closes VOL-UNIT-001).
Envelope schema expanded to the Phase 7 enumerated form (below); free-text statuses prohibited.
Documented fail-open to MC flat blend retained but must stamp fallback_used=true + fallback_reason=GARCH_UNAVAILABLE in vol_input_quality.

3_volatility_concept_registry_ratificati.name_overload_check: PASS — no ratified name carries two meanings; legacy vix_*/iv_level overloads resolved by alias table

4_ticker_class_mapping_ratification.registry: versioned instrument-class registry owned by instrument_identity.py (already owns VIX/VXN/RVX broker roots at instrument_identity.py:22)

classes.rule: SPX-tracking index products and broad SP500 ETFs
classes.operator_explanation: VIX is both macro and native for SP500 cone

classes.fallback: native UNAVAILABLE -> macro overlay remains; no substitution into native field
classes.operator_explanation: VXN is Nasdaq-100 native vol; VIX kept as macro overlay

classes.rule: DEFAULT class: any symbol not matching an index-cone rule (equities, sector ETFs, thematic ETFs)
classes.fallback: no chain -> native_iv_status=UNAVAILABLE; realized_vol NEVER copied into native_iv field
classes.operator_explanation: no listed vol index; chain ATM IV is the native measure

amendments.change: single_equity_guest is the governed DEFAULT class — classification is total by construction; leveraged/inverse ETFs and no-chain symbols fall here with chain_required=False handling (native UNAVAILABLE), no ad hoc exceptions.
SPX aliases (SPX, $SPX, bare roots) resolve through instrument_identity broker-root normalization BEFORE classification; the registry keys on normalized roots.
Insufficient-liquidity chains classify normally but emit native_iv_status=INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY (quality gate, not class change).

parameters.target_maturity: nearest listed expiry with DTE in [7,45]; prefer closest to 30 DTE
parameters.interpolation: none in v1 — single-expiry ATM read (matches existing atm_iv usage); variance-interpolated 30d is a versioned future upgrade
parameters.atm_definition: strike nearest spot; if tie, lower strike
parameters.quote_basis: midpoint of bid/ask; theoretical/last prohibited as IV basis
parameters.crossed_or_locked: discard pair -> quality PARTIAL or UNAVAILABLE
parameters.min_quote_count: both legs present with positive bid
parameters.min_oi_or_volume: not required in v1 (spread gate is the liquidity gate); revisit with data
parameters.timestamp_alignment: chain snapshot ts within one refresh cycle of spot ts else STALE
parameters.corporate_events: chain replaced by adjusted chain post-event; no smoothing across event boundary
parameters.premarket: previous RTH close chain marked STALE; permitted for display only
parameters.replay: reconstruct from persisted percent iv_level column with builder conversion; provenance route=replay
parameters.macro_substitution: PROHIBITED — macro never impersonates native/chain IV
parameters.rv_substitution: PROHIBITED into native_iv field; RV remains its own concept
parameters.substitution_provenance: any permitted fallback changes provenance status, never silently

aliases.disposition: retained as read-only compatibility alias at SignalInput/DB/API
allowed_consumers: existing consumers frozen at ratification list; NEW money-path code must use canonical name
aliases.removal_condition: all consumers migrated + one full retrain cycle on canonical columns
aliases.test: checker rejects new vix_level reads outside allowlist
aliases.serialization: DB/API column names unchanged during alias window

aliases.disposition: alias; dual-unit boundary frozen (decimal internal / percent serialized)

rules: No legacy alias may be written by any code other than the canonical builder
No NEW consumer may read a legacy alias (mechanical allowlist)
Aliases are translation-at-boundary only — one adapter, not an alternate input path
Model artifacts trained during the alias window record which names they consumed in artifact metadata

UNAVAILABLE.monte_carlo: only via documented GARCH/blend fallback path with fallback_used stamp

FALLBACK.model_inference: only if fallback is in training distribution (same fallback active in training rows)

semantically_equivalent: serialized percent forms (exact conversion function, tolerance 0 — conversion is deterministic *100/100)
card text rendered from same enum

explicit_rules: unit conversion exclusively in canonical builder; replay uses THE SAME builder
timestamp normalization: all routes stamp as_of_ts from source cycle, never wall-clock at read time
missing values: None + status on every route — a route may not invent presence
unavailable native vol: identical UNAVAILABLE status across routes for same as-of input
stale macro: identical STALE classification given same age at as-of
chain-derived: same chain snapshot -> same ATM read on live and replay
alias translation at one boundary adapter
consumer views are projections of one envelope — never re-derivations
semantic version equality asserted train vs live at scheduler preflight
golden_record_assertions: GR-1: immutable golden snapshot row -> live builder vs replay builder produce field-identical SignalInput vol fields (decimal) and identical vol_input_quality
GR-2: golden row with percent iv_level=18.5 -> both builders emit 0.185 (kills VOL-UNIT-001)
GR-3: golden row missing vix prev -> both emit market_iv_change=None + UNAVAILABLE
GR-4: golden VXN-missing row for QQQ -> native UNAVAILABLE; market fields unaffected
GR-5: same golden row serialized to API and DB -> percent forms equal round-trip via exact conversion
GR-6: contract_version mismatch fixture -> scheduler preflight fails

fields.name: native_iv_level
fields.producer: canonical builder <- VXN/RVX quote or chain ATM

fields.name: forecast_vol_bars
fields.fallback: None -> MC flat blend + FALLBACK stamp

4 route migration (live, replay through same builder)
7 unit guards (range assertions at builder + consumers)

market_state.py (build_market_state accepts vol context; stamps vix_direction/vix_vs_prev from it)
features/replay_signal_input_v1.py (route iv_level/realized_vol through vol_percent_to_decimal — closes VOL-UNIT-001; stamp route_identity=replay)
tests/test_replay_signal_input_v1.py (extend: unit conversion + golden parity GR-1/GR-2/GR-3)
tests/test_market_context_fetch_fail_closed.py or existing market_state test owner (extend: stamp parity)
functions: server: snapshot/publish cycle around server.py:6739-6878 and 7245-7252 — single computation consumed by all three surfaces
market_state.build_market_state signature + SignalInput stamp block market_state.py:1290-1312
intended_changes: compute market_iv_change/direction ONCE per cycle in server; pass into build_market_state; stamp identical values on SignalInput, snapshot row, ms_dict
replay builder converts percent columns to decimal via the same vol_percent_to_decimal
no new fields; no DB schema change; no ML feature change
tests: route-parity unit: one fake cycle -> SignalInput.vix_direction/vix_vs_prev == snapshot row == ms_dict
vol_regime rapid branch fires with stamped vix_vs_prev fixture
replay golden: percent row 18.5 -> 0.185 both fields
replay golden: live-built vs replay-built SignalInput vol fields identical for same row
golden_records: GR-1 golden snapshot row fixture (checked-in dict, no DB dependency)
V1.ticker_coverage: universal by construction — no ticker literals in changed paths; fixture tickers arbitrary
acceptance: no training column change (schema diff empty)
V1.rollback: vol context param defaults None (current behavior); replay conversion behind same commit revert

reasons: sequencing: V1 must land and prove golden parity first (dependency order frozen above)
V2 DB migration (native_iv columns) should not land while replay route still violates unit contract
live VXN/RVX RTH wire proof required as part of V2 acceptance, not available in this read-only mission
unblock_conditions: operator confirms chain-derived spread gate 0.25 and DTE window [7,45] defaults

mission_closure_note: MISSION_CLOSURE reported NOT_CLOSED at the proof-label ladder level: the CLOSED_WITH_EVIDENCE label is retroactive-only under FULL_FIXES_ONLY_V2 (requires a concrete commit SHA plus CI run ids, which an uncommitted read-only mission cannot possess). All mission deliverables are complete; ladder label for this packet: REPORTED_PROVEN_NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED.
